gorillaUpdate.notes: [required] Packs that are already in your game get updated in place (no second copy, no refusal), also when you copied them in by hand first or when they sit on a free number. Needed for Legends Arrival Pack 1.1, which opens all its entrances to every wrestler. Gorilla now tells you when Windows gives it no file, when it is busy, or when it runs as administrator, and Fix my game warns when your bake is turned off.
